## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes; PR publication checks pass on the final head.
- [ ] Sources and claims reviewed; reported findings and our assessment are clear.
- [ ] Versioned R2 URLs open and match the approved images; no image binaries/Base64.
- [ ] Article: title/metadata → one infographic → text; no production captions/Download.
- [ ] Cover is readable at 352px and 260px; pair follows its domain palette/motif.
- [ ] Home, archive, affected tags/articles inspected on desktop and mobile.
- [ ] External source opens a new tab and the article remains open.

Evidence: commands/results, screenshots and media checks. For an inapplicable
item, explain why instead of marking it complete. Shared template changes need
all published articles checked. Rules/checks-only changes may document the
product-file/output comparison, with any differences, instead of new screenshots.

## Release

Andrew (`AR1314`) reviews the final PR head in GitHub. After any further commit,
obtain approval of the new head. Merge only after approval and successful checks;
then record the Pages deployment result and live-page verification.
